text:
Predicates:
FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to airport y.
FliesFrom(x, y) ::: x flies from airport y.
SameAirport(x, y) ::: x and y are the same airport.
Premises:
FliesTo(susan, lga) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
¬∃z (FliesTo(x, z) ∧ FliesFrom(x, z)) ::: The departure and arrival can not be the same airport.
FliesFrom(john, lga) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
FliesTo(john, lga) ::: John flies to LGA airport.
